headline: Japan and US jointly intervene in forex market to maintain yen's value
summary: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said Japan and the US have conducted a joint intervention to maintain the value of the yen. The move aims to support the currency.
why: Currency intervention by Japan's Ministry of Finance and other authorities can sharply shift USD/JPY and affects exporters, importers and global carry trades.
why_moved: Japan and the US have jointly intervened in the forex market to maintain the yen's value, according to Japan's finance minister.
